title: What to do if you get a flat tire on the highway
desc: Stay safe in heavy traffic while replacing or servicing a flat tire.
todos: Ease off the accelerator gradually and signal to pull onto the far right shoulder away from traffic.
Turn on hazard lights immediately and set your emergency parking brake.
Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts fastened if pulled over on a narrow highway shoulder.
Call roadside assistance (AAA, insurance provider, or highway patrol) for assistance in high-traffic zones.
Only attempt changing the tire yourself if safely parked on flat ground completely clear of moving lanes.
